dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Honey, I'm back!

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: Oh! Back so soon?
I've hardly started dinner!

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: I had an early start this morning.
Need an extra hand?

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: No thank you, dear.
You've already done so much around the farm, I can handle dinner.
You should relax!

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: It's hard to relax when there is still so much to do...
I'm the one that said we should move out here.
I'm starting to wonder if that was a dumb decision...

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: I've never regretted a second being here.
It doesn't matter where we are, as long as we're together, I'm happy.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: I don't deserve you.

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: Hehe, that's what they all say.
Now why don't I help you relax a little more?
You must be so tense. Let me give you a hand.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Actually, I don't feel as sore as-- uughh--

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: Hehe, maybe you are just a dumb farmer.
Working out in the sun all day must've turned your brain to mush.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Haah... maybe you're right.. Ahh...
It doesn't help that you're draining all of the blood from my head now, too.

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: It's okay, it's looks like it's going to a different head, hehe.
Looks like I better give it some special attention.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Ungh...

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: Mwgh, mwgh, mwgh...

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Ahh-- it feels too good!
I don't think I can hold it in any longer!

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: Mmmmm--

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: Hehe, feeling better?

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: I feel like a new man!
Like I've got the strength to plow ten fields!

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: As long as you make time to plow mine.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Of course!
Truth be told... I was worried about moving to the countryside.
Away from all of our friends and family, starting over.
With all of that news about ancient Tah'Lo artifacts, the world seems to be spinning faster and faster.
A quiet life with you is all I need.

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: I couldn't agree more.
I am curious, though. They say the ancient Tah'Lo people were incredibly advanced.
I wonder what kind of amazing things they could do...

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Beats me.
As long as it doesn't involve me, they can have all of the artifacts they want.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Huh? Someone's at the door?
All the way out here?

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Hello. Apologies for the intrusion.
My name is Hegseth. I am a member of the Kings council.
What a wonderful home you have.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Thank you.
Is there something I can help you with?

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Yes, indeed.
As I am sure you are aware, our great King Reiss (long may he reign), has declared that all Tah'Lo artifacts be relinquished to local authorities.
It is for the safety and prosperity of the people that our king has decreed it.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: That's fine, but we don't have any Tah'Lo artifacts.
I couldn't even tell you if I saw one.

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: I see.
Well then, you wouldn't mind if we inspected the area?
It is typical for Tah'Lo artifacts to go unnoticed by ...commoners.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Is that necessary? There is nothing here but wheat and pig crap.

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: I assure you it will not take long.
We would hate to send word to the king that some folk have been uncooperative...

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Good.
Now then...
Men!

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: Yes, sir!

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Search the area for any Tah'Lo artifacts.
Be thorough, I will not tolerate any mistakes.

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: Yes, sir!

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Did you find anything?

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: Nothing, sir. Checked every nook and cranny.

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Hmm. Perhaps you are telling the truth.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Now if you're done, I'd like you to leave. I have work to do.

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Of course, of course!
There's just one last thing...
The lady's bracelets.
Hand them over.

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: What? My bracelets?
These aren't Tah'Lo artifacts. These are just ordinary bracelets.

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: That will be for the king to decide.

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: What? No!
There must be a mistake.
These were a gift from my mother! I can't give them away!

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Such a shame.. But your mother will be proud of you for being a devout citizen of the kingdom.
Now let me take those off your hands--

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Stop right there. That's enough.
We told you we don't have any relics.
I am going to have to ask you and the men you brought to leave.

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: I would think very carefully about what you are doing, boy.
To defy me, is to defy your king.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: I won't ask you again.

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Very well. You leave me no choice then.
Soldier! Grab the woman and take the bracelet! Kill them both if you have to.

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: Yes, sir!

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: Ah-

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Astrid!!!

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: What the--

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: Ack!

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: Oof--

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: What the...
Astrid, what's happening?

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: I don't know. I just felt a surge of power coming from my bracelets!

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: What are you doing, soldier?? Kill her!

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: Uh...
Yes, sir!

dialogueEntries.name: Soldier
lines: Urgh...

dialogueEntries.name: Hegseth
lines: Useless...
Retreat! We'll regroup outside and take the relic by force!

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Argh. That doesn't sound good.
Astrid, are you okay?

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: *huff huff*
Yes, I'm okay.
I just need to catch my breath then I'll be ready to fight.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: No, you should stay here. I can handle this.

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: No way.
I am just as much a fighter as you.
We will protect our home together.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Okay, stay near me.
Let's do this.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: It's been a while since we've been in battle.
Let's take this slowly.
I'll charge the enemy, you support me from behind.

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: Let's do this!

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Phew... I don't know the last time I swung a sword.
Or killed a man..
It's done now, we're safe.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: What's wrong? Are you okay?

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: What are we going to do now? We can't stay here.
As long as I have these bracelets, we'll never be safe.
Maybe I should've just handed them over.

dialogueEntries.name: MainCharacter
lines: Absolutely not.
We're going to speak with Lord Beesly, in town. I've known him to be an honorable man.
He will speak to the royal envoy and fix this.

dialogueEntries.name: Astrid
lines: *sigh* And just as we were getting settled in...
